verdict.rationale: Insomnia's Collection Runner and CLI (inso) let users execute unlimited requests/tests in a collection in one pass, and pre-request scripts/chaining support automation across many requests, which covers bulk test/automation workflows. However there is no evidence of bulk editing, tagging, or batch modification of many items (e.g., renaming, deleting, or updating many requests/environments at once) beyond running them, so the story is only partially delivered. Missing for 10: explicit bulk edit/delete/update operations across items, independent hands-on confirmation of large-scale bulk runs.
